# German Company Handelsregister & KYB Risk Audit Sample (50 Companies)

[![Apify KYB Actor](https://img.shields.io/badge/Apify-German%20KYB%20Actor-FF7626?logo=apify&logoColor=white)](https://apify.com/AGrunert/german-company-kyb-insolvency-scraper)
[![Fiverr KYB Gig](https://img.shields.io/badge/Fiverr-Custom%20KYB%20Audit-1DBF73?logo=fiverr&logoColor=white)](https://www.fiverr.com/s/yeWblEA)
[![GitHub Suite](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-German%20B2B%20Suite-blue?logo=github)](https://github.com/andregrunert-ctrl/german-b2b-data-suite)

A curated, live-verified 50-company Know-Your-Business (KYB) sample dataset of German corporations (`AG`, `SE`, `KGaA`, `GmbH`) extracted directly from the official German Federal Judicial Portals (`handelsregister.de` and `insolvenzbekanntmachungen.de`).

---

## Overview & Scope

- **Official Sources:** Common Register Portal of the German Federal States (`www.handelsregister.de`, structured XJustiz 3.5.1 `SI` XML & `UT` filings) cross-checked against official German Insolvency Announcements (`www.insolvenzbekanntmachungen.de`).
- **Scope:** 50 verified German corporate entities across major federal states and register courts (`Amtsgerichte`), including blue-chip corporations, tech scale-ups, and active/historical insolvency examples.
- **Formats Included:**
  - `DE_Handelsregister_KYB_Sample_50.csv` (RFC 4180 UTF-8 CSV, comma-delimited `,`, dot decimal `.`, `snake_case` headers)
  - `DE_Handelsregister_KYB_Sample_50.xlsx` (Styled 2-sheet Excel workbook with freeze panes, formatted share capital in EUR, conditional risk status formatting, and federal state & legal form statistics)
  - `DE_Handelsregister_KYB_Sample_50.json` (Clean flat JSON array)

---

## Data Dictionary

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `company_name` | String | Official registered company name |
| `kyb_risk_status` | String | `CLEAR` or `WARNING_INSOLVENCY_FOUND` |
| `state` | String | German federal state (*Bundesland*) |
| `register_court` | String | Competent register court (*Amtsgericht*) |
| `register_type` | String | Register department (`HRB`, `HRA`, `GnR`, `PR`, `VR`) |
| `register_number` | String | Official registration number |
| `register_id` | String | Combined register identifier (e.g., `HRB 48720`) |
| `legal_form` | String | Corporate legal form (`SE`, `Aktiengesellschaft`, `GmbH`, `KGaA`) |
| `status` | String | Register status (`aktuell`, `in Liquidation`, etc.) |
| `seat` | String | Registered corporate seat (*Sitz*) |
| `address` | String | Registered business street address (*Geschäftsanschrift*) |
| `share_capital` | Float | Registered share/nominal capital (`Stammkapital` / `Grundkapital`) |
| `currency` | String | Capital currency (`EUR`) |
| `officers_count` | Integer | Total extracted managing directors, board members, and `Prokuristen` |
| `managing_directors_sample` | String | Semicolon-delimited top officers (`Vorstand` / `Geschäftsführer` / `Prokurist`) |
| `business_purpose` | String | Registered corporate object (*Unternehmensgegenstand*) |
| `has_insolvency_record` | Boolean | `true` if insolvency announcements matched, else `false` |
| `insolvency_cases_count` | Integer | Count of matched official insolvency publications |
| `insolvency_details` | String | Publication date, insolvency court, and court file numbers |
| `handelsregister_url` | String | Official source portal URL |
| `scraped_at` | String | UTC ISO-8601 extraction timestamp |
